rv.q: Kokandy Productions redefines the cult classic of A Clockwork Orange with fresh theatrics and a visual performance that will stay with audiences long after leaving the theatre.
Kokandy’s production lets Burgess’ point of view speak for itself; a dark foreshadowing of technologies to come.
In most other ways, though, this production is a valiant failure.
Kokandy Productions has launched a universally relevant social commentary inside a horror story, a ballet of malicious redemption.
I think one walks away from this 100 minutes of Theater Art with thoughts about creating a more acceptable monster.

cn.t: Kokandy's *A Clockwork Orange* earns mostly strong notices for its bold staging, movement, and dark energy, though at least one critic finds the material unpalatable regardless of execution. A stylish, divisive ride.
